contamination_risks: Every warmup, development, and confirmation pair was absent from the global exposure index before freeze.
The adverse predecessor contributes no promotion evidence.
The complete 32-trial grid is unchanged; no predecessor outcome repaired a parameter.
Confirmation prices remain inaccessible until an exact winner is frozen.
entry_rule: Require completed internal bar strength at or below the frozen threshold, a completed one-session decline at least the frozen cost-clearing floor, and close above the frozen SMA; rank the lowest internal bar strength and enter at the next session open.
exit_rule: Resolve stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the completed close after one or two sessions.
expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry, and flat within two sessions.
falsifiers: closing-location effect fails outside concentrated crisis trades
material_difference_rationale: No signal, parameter, execution, cost, or selection gate changes. Nine liquid U.S. broad, size, and style ETFs with globally untouched 2008-2014 pairs test whether the exact IBS mechanism generalizes beyond the adverse predecessor universe.
mechanism: Completed-session closing pressure inside liquid equity ETFs can reverse after constrained end-of-day liquidity demand clears.
primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Fresh quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timestamp, GTC protection, and before-open reconciliation remain mandatory.
ranking_rule: Lowest completed internal bar strength, then most negative one-session return, then canonical symbol.
selection_rule: At most one new family entry per day under all portfolio risk, notional, daily-entry, and capital-contention caps.
stop_rule: Use one or one-and-a-half completed ATR14 below entry; missing or structurally invalid protection is a missed trade.

universe_requirements.selection_basis: Nine U.S. broad, equal-weight, small-cap, mid-cap, value, growth, and completion ETFs with pre-2008 history and globally untouched target pairs.
